svg.title: Сведение рук на нижнем блоке поочерёдно — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Correct BOTH raised arms. Raised hand reaches diagonally FORWARD across chest, away from torso at shoulder level. Keep raised elbow nearly straight, not bent in a biceps curl. In each pose opposite arm stays low. Cables remain continuously connected to both low pulleys. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
